parameters.name: ActionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the rule action to modify.

This is the rule action ID returned after you call [CreateRuleAction](~~69586~~) to create a rule action. You can also call [ListRuleActions](~~69517~~) to view the rule action ID in the response.

parameters.name: Configuration
parameters.description: The configurations of the rule action. The required configurations vary based on the rule action type. For more information, see the Configuration description for each rule action type in the supplementary description of request parameters in [CreateRuleAction](~~69586~~).

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the rule action. Valid values:

<props="china">- **DATAHUB**: forwards topic data processed by the data forwarding rule to Alibaba Cloud DataHub for data stream processing.</props>
<props="china">- **ONS**: forwards topic data processed by the data forwarding rule to ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ for MSMQ distribution.</props>
- **MNS**: forwards topic data processed by the data forwarding rule to Alibaba Cloud Message Service for message transmission.
- **FC**: forwards topic data processed by the data forwarding rule to Alibaba Cloud Function Compute for event computing.
- **REPUBLISH**: forwards topic data processed by the data forwarding rule to another IoT Platform topic.
- **AMQP**: forwards data to an AMQP consumer group.
- **OTS**: forwards topic data processed by the data forwarding rule to Alibaba Cloud Tablestore for NoSQL data storage.

> - Rules whose data format is binary (the **DataType** parameter of the rule is set to **BINARY**) do not support forwarding data to Tablestore.
- The cloud products to which the rules engine DPI engine can forward data vary by region. For more information, see [Regions and zones](~~85669~~) that are active for the rules engine.
